purpose: Describe the verified star-tracker frame correction without redistributing upstream source context.

changes.description: Preserve the sensor-frame attitude measurement; defer mounting to attitude determination.

implementation.patchEvidence: The script generates a source patch from the pinned original files inside the isolated Linux guest for each run. The generated patch is retained in the private run evidence; this recipe contains no upstream source context.

verificationScope: Selected native NOS3/cFS/42 star-tracker software chain; no flight qualification or full-mission acceptance is implied.
